periods.label: 无法观测的学生会副会长
titles: 破军学园学生会副会长
periods.occupation: student knight; student council vice president

appearance.overview: Very small boy with dark silver messy hair, dull golden eyes and a mask-like smile, despite wearing a Hagun uniform.

personality.summary: Playful and unreadable, appearing without presence and speaking lightly even after violence.

relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council colleague who accompanies him.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Heals Ikki after Kuraudo's provocation and reassesses him as a true knight chick.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Recognizes him as a dangerous mad dog from Donrou.

periods.summary: Utakata appears suddenly on the restaurant table after Kuraudo leaves, revealing Kuraudo's identity as Donrou's ace Sword Eater. He praises Ikki for avoiding a public brawl, then touches Ikki's wound and makes it vanish instantly, showing a power distinct from ordinary healing. He says he is not in the selection battles and leaves with Kanata.

key_events.summary: Appears with Kanata, identifies Kuraudo and erases Ikki's wound.

periods.time: Student council involvement in final selection arc
periods.label: 无法观测的支援
titles: 破军学园学生会副会长
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy student council; Wakaba Home

status.current: serves as student council support and becomes a Seven Stars representative

relationships.toka-todo: Childhood friend from Wakaba Home; understands her nurturing strength and supports her before the Ikki duel.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Explains Toka's burden to Ikki and later helps rescue him and Stella in Okutama.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Fellow student council member and old friend.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Fellow student council member; shares the council's chaotic domestic dynamic.

periods.summary: Utakata displays the student council's playful dysfunction, but also provides crucial context about Toka's strength. He tells Ikki that Toka's power is rooted in selfless love and the expectations of Wakaba Home's children. During the Okutama incident he arrives by using Absolute Uncertainty to guarantee his route to Ikki and Stella, demonstrates his causality-interference defense, and brings Toka to finish the stone puppets. Before the final duel he reassures Toka that she should fight as herself despite the adults' dirty scheme. He is later listed as one of Hagun's Six representatives, though absent from the ceremony only Nagi is specified.

key_events.summary: Appears in the student council chaos and mission planning.
Explains Toka's Wakaba Home origin and burden to Ikki.
Uses Absolute Uncertainty to bring Toka to the ambush.

abilities: Absolute Uncertainty / Black Box causality interference

periods.time: Seven Stars opening day at Hagun hospital
periods.label: 仍在昏睡的副会长
titles: 破军学园学生会副会长
periods.occupation: student knight; student council vice president

status.current: asleep from extreme fatigue after Ouma's Fantasy Form attack, expected to wake soon

relationships.toka-todo: Student council president recovering in the neighboring bed.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council ally who tells Toka he is safe.

periods.summary: Utakata does not actively participate in the volume but is shown in the Hagun hospital bed beside Toka. Kanata explains that he, like Toka, is only sleeping from extreme exhaustion after the Akatsuki attack and is not in life-threatening danger.

key_events.summary: His condition is explained when Toka wakes.

periods.label: 泡沫苏醒并警告厄运
periods.occupation: student council vice president; student knight

status.current: awakens after more than a week unconscious from the Akatsuki attack

personality.summary: Normally airy, but wakes in panic because his battle with Amane taught him that fighting Amane risks irreversible disaster.
fears: irreversible outcomes caused by Amane's power

relationships.toka-todo: Hospital neighbor and student council president who explains current events after he wakes.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Opponent who defeated him during the Hagun attack with a power far worse than future prediction.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: One of the people Utakata indirectly tries to warn through calls/messages.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Present in the hospital and confirms he slept over a week.

periods.summary: Utakata wakes in the hospital after sleeping for over a week following the Akatsuki attack. At first confused, he panics when he learns the Seven Stars tournament has begun and that Amane Shinomiya is about to fight. He warns Touka and Kanata that Amane's power is not future prediction, but something more violent and absolute, beyond normal strength comparisons. His warning becomes a crucial external confirmation of Ikki's later deduction that Amane can bend causality or luck to fulfill wishes, even overcoming Utakata's own Absolute Uncertainty.

key_events.summary: Wakes and urgently warns that nobody should fight Amane.
His defeat helps Ikki reason out Amane's real causality/luck ability.

periods.label: 怪谈会的副会长
titles: 破军学园学生会副会长

status.role: plans the ghost-story慰劳会 and joins the search

personality.summary: Playful, irreverent and prank-friendly; he wants the ghost event to be entertaining but still recognizes the seriousness of special-individual rules.

relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Old prank partner and student council colleague.
relationships.toka-todo: President whom he teases but follows.
relationships.renren-tomaru: Student council colleague who reacts with him to the search plan.

periods.summary: Utakata opens the student-council gathering by telling a frightening story, then helps turn Kanata's real poltergeist footage into a test-of-courage search. He jokes about searching the guard room and later notes that a special individual animal that attacked people would normally be subject to humane destruction, prompting the explanation of Kanata's rescue arrangement.

key_events.summary: Hosts the ghost-story gathering and participates in the poltergeist response.
